architecture.modelFlow: Composer -> AgentEngine -> ProviderProtocol/QNetworkAccessManager -> canonical history plus AgentPresentation -> ConversationView.
architecture.tools: Builtins -> ToolExecutor; opaque external requests -> per-chat AgentToolHost -> SandboxHost/BrowserToolBridge/NetworkBroker/MiniAppHost.
architecture.worker: Out-of-process native QuickJS with bounded correlated JSON IPC; host retains filesystem/browser/credential authority.
architecture.context: AttachmentStore original bytes + per-agent FileReadSnapshotStore leases -> AttachmentPipeline transient provider requests from persisted references.
architecture.persistence: Revision-locked atomic SessionStore JSON with durable cleanup markers; DPAPI provider storage; per-agent app/attachment/read roots.
architecture.browser: Native Qt/COM loader and installed Evergreen; shared ordinary browser registry and agent-owned mini-app views.
architecture.terminalGit: ConPTY/libvterm and installed Git/shell under user OS permissions.
architecture.limits: Windows-specific CMake; MainWindow remains orchestration layer. No stable versioned SDK yet. Preserve ownership/cancel/mount/persistence boundaries when copying components.
